nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData: an empty Settings table reaches Validate, which fails the tool (-> WF-6) instead of ending the run silently.

nodes.name: Client Appts
nodes.notes: The client's live visits (booked/reminded/confirmed): Validate keeps replaces_appt_id only if it is one of them and still ahead. client_id goes into the formula only if it is a plain id.

nodes.name: Cancel Old
nodes.notes: One update per earlier pending row of this client: a client has at most one live proposal.

nodes.name: Set Name?
nodes.notes: executeOnce: Cancel Old hands over one item per cancelled row; everything from here on must run once, or the client would get one new pending row per old one.

nodes.name: Appt Fields
nodes.notes: Create Appt maps its input item automatically, so the item must be exactly the Appointments columns (Validate.fields), one item.
